correctness.rationale: For the explicit 48-element quaternion group, each three-point support is reduced to one of 1081 normalized pairs. Closure under renormalization and group conjugation yields 28 exact action orbits. Integer-valued regular matrices for each representative are ranked over Q with exact symbolic elimination; their ranks are invariant across orbits, which exhaust all pairs. Each orbit contributes exactly 16 times its normalized size to the full 17296 support census. The run executed the supplied standalone checker, including all 110,592 associativity checks, 28 rational ranks, and two independent modular ranks for all 1081 normalized pairs. Modular tests corroborate rather than replace the rational proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete support-classification problem on the smallest nontrivial binary octahedral group, not an arbitrary handpicked numerical slice. The central new mixed-coset regime comprises 13248 supports, exhibits unexpected odd-dimensional kernel 5 alongside dimensions 2 and 8, and is classified by a simple intrinsic invariant (three quotient orders). Exact global multiplicities and a unique extremizing coset geometry make the result useful for noncommutative Fourier sparsity and singular Cayley operators. The known within-2T corollary is integrated rather than presented as new.
